question: Which of the following dance forms is performed by the Adi tribe of Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tapu**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tapu is a traditional dance form of the Adi tribe of Arunachal Pradesh, which is performed during festivals and rituals.
 
• The dance is usually performed by both **men and women**, who wear traditional costumes and ornaments while dancing.
 
• The movements in Tapu are slow and graceful, with emphasis on **hand and foot gestures**, and the dancers often sing along with the music.
 
• The dance is believed to have **originated** from the **mythological story **of the** Adi tribe**, which tells the tale of a goddess who taught the dance to the people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karma **is a popular folk dance of the **Gond tribe** in **Madhya Pradesh**.

 
 
• Karma, a well-known fall celebration, begins on the **eleventh day of the light** fortnight in the month of **Bhadrab.**
 
 
 
• **Sangphao **is a traditional dance of the** Naga tribe** in **Nagaland**.
 
 
• Two persons chant** invocations **to the spirits to start the dance. 
 
 
 
• Within the** Bastar area of Chhattisgarh state**, the **Abuj Maria tribe** is well-known for their **Kaksar dance.**
